paragraphs: The University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) exhibits a diverse student body with a majority of women, who comprise approximately 75.61% of the enrollment, while men represent about 24.39%. Additionally, about 11.76% of students receive Pell Grants, indicating a portion of the student population benefits from federal financial aid aimed at supporting low-income individuals. This demographic distribution reflects UNT's commitment to serving a varied and inclusive community within its specialized health science education programs.
